title: DojoLiq Kiwi Passionfruit Guava 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Kiwi Passionfruit Guava brings a beloved tropical medley to life with stunning clarity. The inhale introduces the sharp, zesty tang of fresh Kiwi, closely followed by the rich, aromatic sweetness of Passionfruit. The exhale smooths out the entire profile with the lush, creamy notes of ripe Guava, providing a perfectly balanced and deeply vivid flavour experience. This Nicotine Salt e-liquid is mixed to an exact 45% VG / 55% PG ratio, a bespoke split chosen to maximise the specific flavour saturation and wicking speed for this recipe. The result is a crystal-clear taste profile suitable for any MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a smooth draw and efficient nicotine delivery. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. These e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
